action_items: Optional: add testID to the inner Switches inside dealer/borrow/payment SectionRows (currently only the row has testID, not the Switch) — would make automated testing of toggle state easier on web preview. No functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: RN-Web Switch is not directly toggle-able via Playwright on this build (no state change on .check()). Not a regression — same behavior on other switches in the app. Recommend wrapping Switches in custom Pressable+state if web automation becomes important.
401s on initial /api/* load are expected pre-login (auth context fetches before token is restored) — no action required.
